item.title: Illustrated D20 · Every Possible Pair · LightHouse faces
item.description: The D20 from LightHouse, adapted into twenty static numbered views. Each five-second spoken result changes the visible die to the corresponding face. This is one MP4 video, with no chapter per number. The result sequence is the same 400-pair-balanced recording as audio episode 08; the mathematical construction and its limitations are described in that episode's show notes. This experiment is provided as a separate video RSS feed to preserve the ordinary audio podcast's small-download format. Apple Podcasts supports video MP4 RSS episodes, but clients may vary in video playback support.
